description: Converts between Unix epoch timestamps and human-readable dates. Accepts epoch seconds / milliseconds / microseconds (auto-detected by magnitude), ISO 8601 / RFC 2822 strings, or "now". Returns seconds, millis, micros, ISO 8601 UTC, RFC 7231 UTC, the wall-clock time in a requested IANA timezone, and a relative description.

input.description: Epoch timestamp (e.g. "1735689600", "1735689600000"), ISO 8601 / RFC 2822 date string, or "now".

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the wall-clock output (e.g. "Asia/Seoul"). Default UTC.

name: convert_timestamp
title: Convert Timestamp
